title: SessionCommandsChanged
description: The slash commands of a session, menu-ordered and badged — the whole list, every time, so a client never patches: pushed when the engine's own menu changes mid-session (a skill discovered as the agent works in a subdirectory, say). A client that does not know it ignores it.

argumentHint.description: What the command takes after its name — `<file>`, `[on|off]` — or empty.

aliases.description: Other names that run the same command: `/cost` and `/stats` both run `/usage`.

builtin.description: Whether it is the engine's own. Absent or `false` for a command or a skill of the project, of a plugin or of an MCP server.

suggested.description: Whether it belongs to the group shown first.

origin.description: Where a command or a skill comes from — the badge of the menu.

label.description: The name a person reads — without the namespace of a plugin.

shadowed.description: `/name` runs another row: an unmarked row whose name a command of the engine's own also has. Listed, so nothing vanishes in silence.
